# Rollen

> The role builder's Rollen page in the Platform's console, where an administrator gives each role its functions and its people and links it to a Core group of its own.

## Identity

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `L2-PLATFORM-ROLES` |
| Kind | code |
| Owner | `ROLE-ENGINE-OWNER` |
| Level | 2 |
| Parent | `L1-WORKSPACE` |

### Source paths

- `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/admin_roles.py`
- `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/templates/admin_roles.html`

## Purpose

### Responsible for

| Id | Aliases | Statement | Code |
|---|---|---|---|
| `L2-PLATFORM-ROLES/R-1` | `L2-PLATFORM-ADMIN/R-5` | Roles (role builder RB-3, RB-4): the Rollen page shows each role (its functions in words, what it may read, its people) and lets an administrator create, rename and delete a role of the firm's own, change a role's functions and people, and link Administration and Mitglied to their Core groups. The Core is written first and only on an administrator's form: a new role's group before the role, a rename before the role, deleting goes members, Core group, role. Every change writes its audit row by id in the same transaction, and the last active administrator keeps Administration. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/admin_roles.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/templates/admin_roles.html` |

### Not responsible for

- The console's blueprint, its role gates and the people page, where a person's roles are checked (L2-PLATFORM-ADMIN); the routes here are attached to that blueprint with its require_admin.
- The agents of a role, their rows and forms on this page (L2-PLATFORM-AGENTS); the page draws the rows it is given.
- The roles as stored, their audit rows and the claim's groups (identity/roles.py); the Platform's identity package, which has no card.
- A role's data, its dry runs, adopting a group and moving direct grants (RB-5): L2-PLATFORM-ROLE-DATA; the page draws its parts (templates/\_role_data.html) and the part «Darf lesen» from its role_data_part.

### Terms

- role (a name, functions and people, and a Core group of its own; what a person may do comes from her roles' functions, what she may read from their groups)

## Offers

### Operations

| Id | Name | Entrance | Ref |
|---|---|---|---|
| `http.GET.roles` | GET /admin/roles - Rollen: the roles as tabs and the first role's card (Administration) | http | `GET /admin/roles` |
| `http.GET.roles._role_id` | GET /admin/roles/{role_id} - one role's card: functions, data, members | http | `GET /admin/roles/{role_id}` |

| `http.POST.roles._role_id.rename` | POST /admin/roles/{role_id}/rename - rename a role: its Core group first | http | `POST /admin/roles/{role_id}/rename` |
| `http.POST.roles._role_id.functions` | POST /admin/roles/{role_id}/functions - replace a role's functions | http | `POST /admin/roles/{role_id}/functions` |
| `http.POST.roles._role_id.members.add` | POST /admin/roles/{role_id}/members/add - put a person into a role | http | `POST /admin/roles/{role_id}/members/add` |
| `http.POST.roles._role_id.members.remove` | POST /admin/roles/{role_id}/members/remove - take a person out of a role | http | `POST /admin/roles/{role_id}/members/remove` |
| `http.POST.roles._role_id.delete` | POST /admin/roles/{role_id}/delete - delete a role: members, Core group, role | http | `POST /admin/roles/{role_id}/delete` |
| `http.POST.roles.connect` | POST /admin/roles/connect - link Administration and Mitglied to their Core groups | http | `POST /admin/roles/connect` |
| `call.web_interface.admin_roles.attach_role_routes` | attach_role_routes - attaches the Rollen routes to the console's blueprint, behind the gate it is given; returns the page function the agents' role forms answer with | call | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/admin_roles.py#attach_role_routes` |

## To review

| At | Why |
|---|---|
| `/owner` | Proposed owner, as for every card in this repository; one role per component is confirmed by a person (Software Map K4). |
| `/status` | Live or planned is not read from the code; the console is on main and runs where the Platform runs. |
| `/source_paths` | Split from L2-PLATFORM-ADMIN by RB-FIX-1 (2026-11-21, FU-44), the way PMVP-40 split L2-PLATFORM-ACCESS: the admin card was 33,409 tokens against 16,000, and the role builder's pages in one card of their own would still be about 18,900, so they are two cards, Rollen and Agenten. This card took admin_roles.py and its page, L2-PLATFORM-ADMIN/R-5 (now R-1) and the operations and contract lines of its nine routes, each line with its old id as its first alias. The parent L1-WORKSPACE (KnowledgeBase) does not list this card yet. |
| `L2-PLATFORM-ROLES/R-1` | RB-3, RB-4 (work order docs/platform-mvp/work-orders/RB-3-4.md): the routes are attached by attach_role_routes with the console's require_admin, as attach_document_routes is. A Core group the request created and could not use is deleted again and the audit log names it (role.core_group_abandoned); a Core group id is never logged (a tenant may choose a speaking one). Rule 1 (no role gives more than its creator holds) is identity/roles.py grantable, which refuses nobody while admin is one coarse function (RB-10 narrows it there). |
| `/operations` | The routes are attached to the blueprint admin.py passes in, so the code reader shows them without the prefix /admin (e.g. GET /roles @web_interface.admin_roles.bp); the operation ids follow it, the refs name the served path. Backlog row B33 of the Software Map plan. |
| `/contract` | Plan § 7 names Verwaltung only in SHELL POST-01, whose server half ("the server refuses the page otherwise") is each route's N-1 here. The other lines come from the work order RB-3-4.md and its frozen tests. |
| `/uses` | Not declared because they have no card yet: the Platform's identity package (roles, audit). L2-PLATFORM-ADMIN is not declared: this code imports nothing of it; admin.py imports attach_role_routes and passes in its blueprint, gate and page helpers. attach_role_routes and role_agents have no line: plan § 7 gives none. |
